---
title: "DEGinsight benchmark: mechanism recovery, hallucination and cost"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(ggplot2)
bench <- read.csv("scores/benchmark_summary.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
abl <- if (file.exists("scores/ablation_summary.csv"))
  read.csv("scores/ablation_summary.csv") else NULL
```

## Model ranking

```{r}
knitr::kable(read.csv("scores/model_ranking.csv"), digits = 3,
             caption = "Per-model mean mechanism-recovery (keyword + judge), hallucination rate and cost per dataset")
```

## Recovery vs hallucination per dataset

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
ggplot(bench, aes(x = model, y = recovery_keyword, fill = model)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ dataset) + ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(y = "mechanism recovery rate", title = "Ground-truth mechanism recovery") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")

ggplot(bench, aes(x = model, y = hallucination_rate, fill = model)) +
  geom_col() + facet_wrap(~ dataset) +
  labs(y = "hallucination rate", title = "Hallucinated pathway citations") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), legend.position = "none")
```

## Cost-performance trade-off

```{r}
agg <- aggregate(cbind(recovery_keyword, cost_usd) ~ model, bench, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
ggplot(agg, aes(cost_usd, recovery_keyword, label = model)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) + geom_text(vjust = -1) +
  labs(x = "mean cost per dataset (USD)", y = "mean recovery rate")
```

## Ablation

```{r}
if (!is.null(abl)) {
  print(ggplot(abl, aes(factor(top_n), recovery_keyword, color = few_shot,
                        group = few_shot)) +
          stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "line") +
          stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point") +
          facet_wrap(~ tissue, labeller = label_both) +
          labs(x = "top_n pathways", y = "mean recovery rate",
               title = "Ablation: few-shot x top_n x tissue context"))
  knitr::kable(aggregate(cbind(recovery_keyword, hallucination_rate) ~
                           few_shot + top_n + tissue, abl, mean), digits = 3)
}
```
